h_h2_b: Four steps from loan request to repayment.
s1_p: Choose the amount, interest rate and duration, or opt for an instant loan at a predefined rate.
s2_p: Your request is listed on the marketplace. An investor funds your loan, with no central lender involved.
s3_p: Send Bitcoin to an on-chain multi-sig escrow address. You never give up your private keys.
s4_p: The loan is sent to your bank account. Repay at maturity and your Bitcoin is returned to your wallet.
w_h2_b: Borrow against Bitcoin, or fund loans secured by it.
w_b_p: Use your Bitcoin as collateral to borrow fiat (EUR, CHF, CZK) or stablecoins (USDC). Keep your Bitcoin exposure and access liquidity without selling. LTV up to 50%, terms from 3 to 24 months, rates from 5% p.a.
w_i_p: Provide fiat or stablecoins to fund Bitcoin-backed loans and earn the interest paid by borrowers. Collateral is locked in on-chain escrow. No rehypothecation, no altcoins. Minimum from EUR 800.
q1: What happens if Bitcoin's price falls?
a1: If the value of your collateral falls, you may need to add Bitcoin or the collateral may be liquidated to repay the loan, as set out in Firefish's terms. Check the exact thresholds on Firefish before you borrow.
a2: Your Bitcoin is locked in an on-chain multi-sig escrow. Virtuse never holds coins, keys or money; Firefish acts as a technology facilitator between borrowers and investors.
q3: Is the loan or the interest taxable?
a3: It depends on your country. Our country tax guides summarise the rules for 13 EU countries. This is general information, not tax advice.
b_get_p: Market, policy, mining. No tokens. No PR. One email, every Monday.
